SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_type, r.last_time, COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) AS userCount FROM safety_sys_role r LEFT JOIN safety_sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.del_flag = 0 WHERE r.delete_falg = '0'
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleName}, '%')
AND r.role_type = #{query.roleType}
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleCode}, '%')
GROUP BY r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_type, r.last_time ORDER BY r.last_time DESC
